scope_notes: Trusted test host injects server RepositoryContext. This is backend authorization verification, not acceptance of a production IdP/session/CSRF deployment.
Local full KB antivirus fixture is explicitly SYNTHETIC_SECURITY_SIGNATURES:EICAR_ONLY. Exact-source remote Browser official CVD signature evidence is separately ZIP/member-digest verified.
No general claim of exhaustive penetration testing, converter memory-safety proof or zero-day immunity is made.
reviewed_boundaries: Server-generated tenant object keys; exact object version; part/full hashes and length
Operation grants before cache/idempotency result; actor from server context
Archive raw path checks, symlink/hardlink/special-file refusal, collisions, nested archive refusal, expanded bytes/entries
Parser network=none, read-only root, non-root, no application/database credentials/host workspace/socket mount, bounded RAM/CPU/PIDs/timeout
DOC macro security; DOCX XML only; PDF text/OCR tools offline; HTML plain text; XHTML declaration refusal
Fail-closed scanner errors, encrypted/limit refusal, verified original before attachment/ingestion, independent human review before publish
Scoped original download with attachment/no-store/nosniff/sandbox headers
Published version/labels and audit holds protected; expiry/supersede preserve historical pins
